title: Spatial Reliability & Image Conversations · v0.10.1
changes: Fixed DESCRIBE: actual Meta vision analysis of the selected private JPEG; previous refine prompt no longer masquerades as a description.
Added image-specific multi-turn Meta questions with a compact bubble, native keyboard/voice input, private dialogue history and explicit paid calls.
Added selected 3D-provider preference; Aholo Lux3D now submits and polls actual tasks, instead of silently invoking Meshy.
Aholo image submission uses an expiring signed source URL (two hours) only after paid confirmation; no automatic fallback.
Restored all older private capture sessions through paged XR Library navigation; 3D job polling resumes after XR restart.
Added closable cinema/darkroom image preview directly in XR, no extra network request.
Adjusted image orientation to camera elevation, and independently placed LOG to the camera viewing pitch.
Status updates appear with a medium-fast typewriter reveal and very soft WebAudio typing sounds.
Slowed the 3D mascot to curved floating paths with optional, periodic browser/ElevenLabs speech and subtle expression changes.
Added pinch relocation and sustained little-fingertip deletion of hand-created experimental frames.
Experimental-mode exit cleans input capture without deleting collections; exits are no longer tied to a successful render frame.
No new storage, model or daily usage quotas. Existing watcher unchanged.
